# premonition.dev

> Personal site of Prem Chandrasekaran — software engineer, engineering leader, author, and speaker at Thoughtworks. Writes about AI-assisted development, Domain-Driven Design, software architecture, and engineering leadership.

## Key Pages

- [About](/about): Bio, books, expertise areas, social links
- [Blog](/blog): Technical articles on AI-assisted development, engineering leadership, and software delivery
- [Talks](/talks): Conference presentations with slides
- [Now](/now): What Prem is currently building, reading, and thinking about

## Blog Series: I Code 10x Faster. We Ship at the Same Speed.

A three-part series examining AI coding tools across three real projects — where they accelerate delivery and where they just accelerate rework.

- [Part 1: The Ecosystem](/blog/ai-sdlc-part-1-ecosystem): What AI coding tools can do — Claude Code, Copilot, MCP integrations, skills, subagents. Where it worked: the Claims Management project.
- [Part 2: The Bottlenecks](/blog/ai-sdlc-part-2-bottlenecks): Where delivery breaks down — requirements, architecture, cross-team dependencies, post-coding friction. The illusion of progress.
- [Part 3: Making It Work](/blog/ai-sdlc-part-3-making-it-work): The two-sided formula for AI-augmented delivery. What actually moves delivery speed.

## Books by Prem Chandrasekaran

- [Domain-Driven Design with Java](https://www.amazon.com/Domain-Driven-Design-Java-Practitioners-inventive-ebook/dp/B09MV42W27/): A practitioners' guide to building inventive software
- [Data Architecture in the AI Age](https://learning.oreilly.com/library/view/data-architecture/9781098181185/): Upcoming, published by O'Reilly

## Talks

- [AI-Assisted Development: What Actually Works](/talks/ai-assisted-dev/): Lessons from three real projects. Presented at Arc of AI.
- [Graph-Powered Storyworlds](/talks/graph-powered-storyworlds/): Using Neo4j to keep 1M+ word LitRPG epics coherent with AI. Presented at Neo4J Nodes AI.
